data.narrative:
Copia Automation is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $88.9M to date. Valuation analysis relies on two primary methods calibrated against a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ). The private peer set includes businesses at Series B through Series D stages, with companies such as Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), and Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B).

Stage-progression methodology applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $89M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $151M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $2.0B. The disparity between methods reflects the wide stage distribution within the robotics sector: Series B peers in the sample command valuations near the $1.6B–$2.0B band, while stage-progression anchors more conservatively to deployment capital.

Triangulation across both methods supports a valuation range of $128M to $1.9B, with a median of $901M. The wide spread reflects uncertainty around (i) whether Copia's development trajectory and market traction align with high-valuation Series B comparables or warrant a more measured progression, and (ii) the heterogeneity in robotics company maturity and go-to-market readiness at equivalent stages. A point estimate would require operational and revenue data not present here.
